author: Ari Koslow
title: Addison Barger (elbow) to workout with Blue Jays Friday
desc: Addison Barger is working out with the Blue Jays on Friday.
impact: The Blue Jays are continuing to determine next steps and when Barger can begin a rehab assignment. He has continued to deal with soreness while swinging.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Irvin (shoulder) to throw bullpen Friday
desc: Jake Irvin is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Friday.
impact: Irvin will be throwing his second bullpen. He has been on the injured list for the past month with a right shoulder strain.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Williams (elbow) to make rehab start Sunday
desc: Trevor Williams is scheduled to make a rehab start on Sunday for Single-A Fredricksburg.
impact: Williams underwent an internal brace procedure on his UCL in July last year. He'll likely require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yilber Diaz optioned to Triple-A by Tigers
desc: The Tigers optioned Yilber Diaz to Triple-A Toledo.
impact: Diaz was claimed off waivers by Detroit after he was designated for assignment by the Diamondbacks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wenceel Perez transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Tigers transferred Wenceel Perez to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the Tigers 40-man roster. Perez remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Adley Rutschman (concussion) going through full workday Friday
desc: Adley Rutschman is slated to go through a full workday on Friday.
impact: Rutschman will play catch and take batting practice. He continues to "trend in the right direction."

author: Ari Koslow
title: Graham Pauley recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Marlins recalled Graham Pauley from Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Pauley gets another opportunity in the majors with Connor Norby optioned to Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bobby Witt Jr. (knee) back in lineup Friday
desc: Bobby Witt Jr. is back in the Royals lineup on Friday against the White Sox.
impact: Witt is back in the lineup for the first time since June 18. He is batting second as the designated hitter.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Corey Seager getting day off Friday
desc: Corey Seager is not in the Rangers lineup on Friday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Rangers manager Skip Schumaker said Seager will have regular off days after he was activated from the concussion injured list on Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Keaschall to start in right field Friday
desc: Luke Keaschall is making his first MLB start in right field on Friday against the Rockies.
impact: Keaschall began taking reps in right field. Kody Clemens is starting at second base on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Holliday (groin) back in lineup Friday
desc: Jackson Holliday is back in the Orioles lineup on Friday against the Nationals.
impact: Holliday is in the lineup for the first time since last Saturday. He is batting eighth and back at second base.

author: Ari Koslow
title: CJ Abrams (side) back in lineup Friday
desc: CJ Abrams is back in the Nationals lineup on Friday against the Orioles.
impact: Abrams was absent from the lineup on Tuesday and Thursday. He is starting at shortstop and batting cleanup.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Austin Voth elects free agency
desc: Austin Voth has elected free agency.
impact: Voth passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Stuart Fairchild designated for assignment
desc: The Guardians designated Stuart Fairchild for assignment.
impact: Fairchild loses his spot on the 40-man roster for Cleveland with the promotion of Cooper Ingle to the majors.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cooper Ingle has contract selected by Guardians
desc: The Guardians selected the contract of Cooper Ingle.
impact: Ingle will make his MLB debut on Friday where he is batting fifth and serving as the designated hitter. He slashed .284/.416/.551 with 12 home runs and 41 RBI this season in Triple-A.
